source_name: BQK legacy repository — SistemiIPagesave document folder (quarterly payment tables)
why_relevant: Legacy static folder holding the quarterly payment-systems tables (Tremujor*.pdf in Albanian, Tromesecni*.pdf in Serbian) with transaction-type breakdowns, e-banking accounts and transactions, and KosGIRO material. Bilingual, potentially directory-listable — a high-yield historical archive for instrument-level series.

source_name: BQK/CBK — legacy document repository (/repository/docs/)
why_relevant: The pre-WordPress file tree still serves live documents (payment-system brochures, e-money brochure, regulations on electronic payment instruments, historic annual reports). Because it is a flat path structure it is the most tractable bulk-harvest surface on the CBK site, and it holds material not relinked from the modern navigation.

source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (list of licensed/registered financial institutions)
why_relevant: Authoritative actor map: the periodically-updated register naming every licensed non-bank financial institution, payment institution and e-money issuer in Kosovo — i.e. the complete universe of legal money transfer operators and their local corporate vehicles. Best single snowball source for MTO agent-network research.

entity_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës / gzk.rks-gov.net
source_name: KIESA / Kosovo Exporters Directory (Ministry of Industry, Entrepreneurship and Trade)
why_relevant: Official directory listing Kosovo companies by sector, including ICT firms serving banking. Government-maintained, so it is a durable and citable actor-map source for the local vendor/integrator layer in Albanian.

entity_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës / gzk.rks-gov.net
source_name: Municipal e-Prokurimi sub-portals (e.g. Komuna e Prishtinës)
why_relevant: All 38 municipalities publish their own procurement pages under the kk.rks-gov.net domain. Municipalities buy cash-desk/POS payment acceptance for tax and utility counters, parking payment systems and kiosk terminals — local-level payment-acceptance demand invisible in national statistics.

entity_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës / gzk.rks-gov.net
source_name: RKS Open Data portal — KRPP organisation datasets
why_relevant: Government open-data catalogue entry for the procurement regulator; the canonical place to discover any additional published procurement datasets/resources beyond the OCDS API, with Albanian/Serbian/English metadata.

entity_name: Bank tariff/price-list disclosures surfaced via Albanian media and search
source_name: Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës (Kosovo Banking Association)
why_relevant: Industry body that aggregates member-bank information and publishes sector material (including work on digital/e-banking services in Kosovo); a likely route to sector-level card and channel data and to industry events where terminal statistics are presented.

entity_name: Kosovo commercial bank product pages as vendor tell-tales
source_name: Kosovo bank management/board pages (executive roster for payments & cards)
why_relevant: Official management pages are the authoritative seed list for the executive-signal watchlist: they identify who holds retail/cards/digital portfolios (e.g. Head of Retail Banking Group at BKT Kosova, Head of Cards and POS Business at TEB) so LinkedIn and conference monitoring can be targeted rather than speculative.

source_name: Eurostat — Enlargement policy and statistical cooperation (Statistics Explained) / IPA statistical cooperation programming
why_relevant: Pointer page mapping which EU instruments (IPA multi-beneficiary statistical programmes, global assessments, peer reviews) fund and evaluate Kosovo statistics, and which domestic bodies are counterparts. Snowballs into KAS/CBK statistical-capacity actors and into the specific IPA project documentation.

source_name: STIKK — Kosovo ICT Association member directory
why_relevant: Claims 200+ members covering ~90% of Kosovo's ICT market; the member list is the practical way to identify fintech/payment-technology vendors and POS/software integrators that never appear in BQK registers.

source_name: STIKK — Kosovo ICT Association member directory
why_relevant: Sector association directory enumerating Kosovo ICT companies with self-declared specialisations — the cheapest way to enumerate the local integrator/reseller layer that installs and services ATM/POS estates for Kosovo banks, and to build the actor map for this cell in Albanian.

source_name: UBT Knowledge Center (knowledgecenter.ubt-uni.net) — Albanian theses on Kosovo banking
why_relevant: Open repository of Albanian-language theses ('Sistemi bankar në Kosovë') that compile historical branch/ATM/card series and often reproduce data obtained directly from banks or BQK for years no longer available online. Excellent for back-series reconstruction.

source_name: Kosovo academic theses citing CBK payment data (UBT Knowledge Center and similar repositories)
why_relevant: Local theses on electronic payments in Kosovo reproduce and sometimes reconstruct CBK card/ATM/POS series over long horizons, occasionally including tables that are no longer easy to find on the CBK site. A cheap way to recover back-series and to see which CBK tables practitioners actually use.

source_name: ARBK Open (arbk.org) — open mirror of the Kosovo business registry
why_relevant: Third-party open mirror allowing search across registrations, owners, activities and statistics; far easier to query in bulk than the official ASP.NET registry, useful for enumerating fintech/payments-adjacent companies.

source_name: ARBK Open (arbk.org) — civic-society mirror of the Kosovo business registry
why_relevant: Open-data mirror (Open Data Kosovo lineage, code at github.com/opendatakosovo/open-arbk) of ~170k-268k registered businesses with owners, activities and statistics — far easier to query in bulk than the official registry for merchant-universe segmentation, at the cost of freshness/completeness risk.

entity_name: ASEE Investor relations / annual & quarterly reports
source_name: Asseco SEE (ASEE) — group structure and company contacts, incl. Asseco SEE sh.p.k. Prishtina
why_relevant: Confirms a registered Kosovo operating entity (Asseco SEE sh.p.k., Lidhja e Pejes 177, Prishtina), which is the local delivery vehicle for card systems, switches and ATM/POS services. Establishes the actor to track in Kosovo procurement, registry and bank vendor disclosures.

entity_name: LinkedIn company pages of Kosovo banks
source_name: FIKS — Kosovo fintech cluster (under the German-Kosovar Business Association / OEGJK-KDWV)
why_relevant: Industry cluster whose membership roster is effectively a curated directory of Kosovo's non-bank payments and fintech actors (founding members named: Numarics, OneFor, Paysera, Swinto). Cluster events and position papers surface actor-level metrics and policy asks not published elsewhere.

source_name: Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës (Kosovo Banking Association) — Anëtarët (members page)
why_relevant: Canonical member roster of Kosovo's commercial banks; each named member is itself a potential publisher of card/ATM/POS and payment statistics. The association also aggregates sector figures members do not publish individually.

source_name: ARBK Atlas (arbk.atlas-studio.eu) — Kosovo business registry analytics platform
why_relevant: Claims 240,000+ registered companies searchable with CSV export and customizable columns — the most collection-friendly route to a bulk actor universe (filterable to financial/payments activity).

source_name: Entrust / Evolis / IDEMIA — card issuance and instant-issuance vendor sites
why_relevant: Card-personalisation hardware and service suppliers whose partner-locator and case-study pages identify the personalisation bureau serving a market. Relevant to Kosovo given a personalisation centre operates locally (Quipu); these vendors' partner listings can name the Kosovo reseller.

source_name: Kosovo payment-provider aggregator directories (PaymentProviders.io Kosovo, CartDNA Kosovo guide)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregators list which PSPs, gateways and alternative payment methods actually serve Kosovo merchants, including local names (e.g. KujtesaPay) not visible in regulator lists. Useful as a lead generator for the merchant-facing layer, but must be verified against the BQK register.

source_name: Oda Ekonomike e Kosovës (Kosovo Chamber of Commerce)
why_relevant: Cross-sector membership body with regional units; its member directory and sector analyses name merchant-side and service-provider actors (POS acceptance, retail) that no financial register lists.

source_name: OpenWay Group — Way4 platform customer case studies and blog
why_relevant: Way4 is one of the two dominant switch/card-management platforms in the region; OpenWay publishes named bank case studies with migration detail. Useful to establish whether a Kosovo issuer/acquirer runs Way4 versus SmartVista or TranzWare, i.e. which vendor's announcements to watch.

source_name: ResearchGate / Academia.edu — Kosovo payments & informality author clusters
why_relevant: Kosovo academics routinely self-archive full texts here that are otherwise paywalled or absent from institutional repositories (e.g. informal-economy and cashless-payment studies). Best snowballing surface for author networks and unindexed conference papers.

source_name: RIT Kosovo (A.U.K.) — student research / RIT Scholar Works
why_relevant: English-language theses by Kosovo students are deposited in RIT's repository (e.g. 'Fighting Informal Economy: Informal Labor' by Lumbardh Zagragja), giving methodologically explicit informal-economy work on Kosovo. No separate RIT Kosovo repository was found.

source_name: Software Group — payment switch and card management solution / client references
why_relevant: Bulgarian-origin regional fintech integrator selling switch/CMS and agent-banking platforms into SEE microfinance and mid-tier banks — a plausible supplier tier for Kosovo's smaller banks and MFIs; its client pages name institutions.

source_name: Wikipedia — List of banks in Kosovo / Banking in Kosovo
why_relevant: Cheap seed list of licensed banks with official domains, useful only to bootstrap crawler targets; every figure must be re-sourced from the bank's own disclosure.
